$schema_note: Registry of curriculum source documents. Each entry describes ONE official document this platform intends to import. status=PENDING means the document is known to exist (referenced by the DBE) but has NOT been downloaded or parsed yet — no content from it exists in the database. Do not treat a PENDING entry as evidence that any curriculum content has been imported. See ../../README.md and this repo's curriculum-import scripts for how an entry moves to DOWNLOADED -> IMPORTED -> PARSED -> REVIEW_REQUIRED -> VERIFIED -> PUBLISHED.

sources.title: CAPS Intermediate Phase — official document index
sources.note: This is the DBE's index page for Intermediate Phase CAPS documents, not a single downloadable document. This sandbox could not reach education.gov.za to enumerate the individual per-subject PDF links behind it (network egress to that domain is blocked here — confirmed via a direct fetch attempt, not assumed). A human with normal internet access needs to visit this URL, list the actual per-subject/per-grade CAPS PDF links, and add one manifest entry per document below, OR upload the PDFs directly for local parsing (which needs no network access at all).

sources.title: CAPS Senior Phase — official document index
sources.note: Same situation as dbe-caps-intermediate-index — this is an index page, not a single document, and unreachable from this sandbox.

sources.title: Annual Teaching Plans, Senior Phase, 2023 — official document index
sources.note: ATP = sequencing/pacing of CAPS content across the year, distinct from CAPS itself (see curriculum_versions / the CAPS-vs-ATP separation in the schema). Also unreachable from this sandbox. Note the academic_year: an ATP from 2023 needs re-verification against the current year's ATP before being trusted as this year's pacing.
